text: On the 16-core x86_64 box, ~/bin/mmseqs -> ~/mmseqs/bin/mmseqs is an ARM aarch64 static ELF, run through binfmt_misc and /usr/bin/qemu-aarch64-static (seen in pgrep output 2026-10-08). Any mmseqs timing taken here is inflated by emulation and cannot be compared with timings from the 48-thread box.
